notes.title: ATNRPG 1.5.6
notes.content:
Good day everyone! Another quick update with some much requested features:
- Visual Fixes from 1.5.1
- Extra spooks in Act 2
- Most importantly, Custom Keybinds! You can now go into the options menu and change your controls to WASD, E to Interact, whatever.
Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.5.2 Patch
notes.content:
- Changed Credit Sequence for some people's wishes.
Enjoy!

notes.title: ATNRPG 1.5.1
notes.content:
Small, quick update that I was gonna include in 1.6 but decided it would be best not to wait.
All it really does is clarify exit points in the game which some people previously thought of as softlocks or points without return.
I want to clarify that past the intro, you can backtrack to any part of the game. This update doesn't change that, it only clarifies it.
Enjoy!

notes.title: HUGE 1.4 Update
notes.content:
Good Evening everyone! Today, ATNRPG has recieved a HUGE update in preparation for something coming up, which is to be announced...

This update revamps a ton of stuff on the internal side of things. Including:
- NW.js version, allowing the game to run faster
- Full Steam Integration which is packed with a ton of good stuff.

As for the real changes,
- We've now added Steam Cloud! Now if you have multiple computers or a Steam Deck, you'll be able to carry over your saves. 
- You've probably noticed the new achievements on the steam page! These add a bit more replay value, as you'll need to go through multiple runs in order to get all of the achievements, as well as hunt for the secret ones!
- Fullscreen has now been fixed, now scaling the sprites while still retaining a retro feel.

I hope everybody has fun with this, and I'll see you soon!
Join the VWPR Discord here: https://discord.gg/sv5Fk98Awr
(If you have [i]any[/i] problems regarding your save files, reach me at justphillipofficial@gmail.com)

notes.title: ATNRPG NOW AVAILABLE ON MAC!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Along with an update to the Windows build of the game, which touches on certain lore aspects and VWPR stuff, ATNRPG is now available on MacOS!

While the optimization of this build is unclear at the moment, it should work completely fine. So please let me know if there are any issues and I will get to optimizing it ASAP!

notes.title: ATNRPG 1.3
notes.content: ATNRPG 1.3 is generally small compared to the other updates, mostly just a stand-in for the new Mac Support! There are real changes however, including some insight on the Voidway Persistent Realm and how it ties into Liefx! Look for secrets to get an early glimpse of our plans.

notes.title: ATNRPG 1.2.1
notes.content:
Evening everyone! I've just released an update to ATNRPG, which revamps the credit sequence at the end and sheds light to our new logo for the Voidway Persistent Realm. Hoping that you guys enjoy.

FYI: Please reach out if you have any bugs or problems with the game! If anything limits your experience, please contact me at justphillipofficial@gmail.com and I will get to work on fixing it. If not, have fun! :)
